hooks.command: f=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -o '"file_path"[^,}]*' | head -1); case "$f" in *.rs*) cargo fmt --quiet 2>/dev/null; cargo clippy --quiet --message-format=short 2>&1 | grep -E '^(warning|error)' | head -20 ;; *.ts*|*.tsx*) npx prettier --write --log-level silent $(echo "$f" | sed 's/.*: *"//;s/"//') 2>/dev/null ;; esac; true

echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE 'git commit' && { git diff --cached | grep -qE '(BEGIN (RSA|OPENSSH) PRIVATE KEY|password\s*=\s*"[^"]+"|api[_-]?key\s*=\s*"[^"]+")' && { echo 'BLOCKED: possible secret in staged diff' >&2; exit 2; }; }; true
